caption: The drawing features two views of a wooden mechanical toy, rendered in naturalistic colors with detailed wood grain. The upper object shows a rectangular wooden box with open spindle sides and a solid front face that has a small crank. The box's side panels are reddish in color, possibly painted or stained. The lower view displays the same object from a more frontal perspective, revealing additional details: inside the spindled section, there are two bird-shaped figures mounted on vertical rods. Below the birds and spindles is a painted panel that depicts two children with light hair and fair skin, one holding what appears to be a nest with eggs, surrounded by green foliage. The rest of the box's outer surface is painted red. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, and the artist's name, "Chris Makarenos," appears in red text at the bottom right corner.
title: Music Box
